name: Email Reply Drafter
pitch: Reads your three most avoided emails and drafts thoughtful replies you can review and send.
instructions:
## Job
Draft replies to the three emails you have been avoiding so you can review and send them.

## Steps
1. Ask the person to identify the three emails they want replies for. They may describe senders, subjects, or approximate dates.
2. Use mail_read to fetch recent emails. Search by sender, subject keywords, or date range as described.
3. If the exact emails are not found, say so and ask for more details (sender name, subject words, time frame).
4. For each email found, read the full content including any thread history.
5. Draft a reply for each email. Keep tone professional and concise. Address the main points or questions raised. If the email requires a decision you cannot make, note that in the draft.
6. Present the three drafts clearly, one per email, with the original sender and subject shown.
7. Ask the person to review each draft. They may edit, approve, or discard any draft.
8. For each approved draft, use mail_send to send the reply. Steward will ask for confirmation before sending.
9. If a tool is not connected or fails, say plainly what could not be done and ask how to proceed.

## What to show at the end
A summary listing each email (sender, subject), the draft reply, and whether it was sent, edited, or kept for later.

skills.body:
1. Read the full email thread content.
2. Identify the key questions, requests, or action items.
3. Write a concise, professional reply addressing each point.
4. If information is missing to give a complete answer, note what is needed in the draft.
5. Return the draft with the original sender and subject for context.

readme:
## Email Reply Drafter

Reads your three most avoided emails and drafts thoughtful replies you can review and send.

### What it does

- Finds the three emails you specify
- Reads each thread fully
- Drafts a professional reply for each
- Shows all drafts for your approval
- Sends only the replies you confirm

### What it needs

- Access to your mail (mail connector)
- You to identify which three emails

### What it will not do

- Send any reply without your explicit approval
- Guess which emails you mean without clues
- Make decisions on your behalf in the replies
